items.missingBehavior: documents/property-media buckets are public=true with 'select to public'; legal/ID/contract files are world-readable by URL, bypassing RLS.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Buckets private; downloads via short-lived signed URLs; no unauthenticated access to any document; RLS-scoped read enforced.

items.missingBehavior: All writes use service-role client (BYPASSRLS) relying on hand-written org_id filters; 109 tables have no RLS backstop. A single missing predicate = cross-tenant leak.
items.acceptanceCriteria: RLS enabled on all tenant tables; a two-org isolation test passes for every CRM entity; service-role writes wrapped by an org-scoping helper that cannot omit org_id.
testsRequired: two-org isolation integration test per entity
RLS coverage lint (fail build if tenant table lacks policy)

items.missingBehavior: users.status='disabled' is written but never checked at the app guard; a disabled/departed agent keeps full session access; no record transfer on departure.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Disabled user is denied at layout/middleware; departure workflow reassigns owned records to a chosen agent; audit entry written.
items.productDecision: who inherits records on departure (manager choice vs round-robin)

items.missingBehavior: social/service.ts inserts a lead AND a buyer/seller twin without findExistingContact, creating duplicate person rows (contradicts convertLead dedup).
items.acceptanceCriteria: All person-creating paths run through one dedup gate (phone/email normalized); duplicates are merged or linked, never silently duplicated.
testsRequired: social capture of existing contact does not duplicate

items.missingBehavior: No single person entity; a buyer-then-seller is two identities; notes/documents/timeline are multi-FK and fragment per role.
items.acceptanceCriteria: One person entity holds multiple roles without duplication; timeline/notes/documents attach to the person and appear across roles; merge/restore supported.
testsRequired: person holds buyer+seller roles, one identity
note on buyer role visible on person timeline
items.productDecision: migrate existing leads/buyers/sellers into person model vs additive link table

items.missingBehavior: No CSV/Excel import for CRM entities; no mapping/preview/validation/dedup/partial-failure/rollback/history. Migrating off a spreadsheet is impossible in-product.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Upload CSV/Excel → column mapping → preview → validation → duplicate detection → commit with partial-failure report + import history + rollback.
testsRequired: invalid rows reported without aborting batch
items.productDecision: supported entity set for v1 import

items.missingBehavior: No offers table; offers are ephemeral inputs to the negotiation assistant and never saved. Offer→counteroffer→accepted is a manual stage click, not data.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Create/track multiple offers per property/deal with amount, conditions, financing, expiry, status history, counteroffers, and conversion to accepted transaction.
testsRequired: accepted offer advances deal + records win
items.productDecision: offer confidentiality rules (visible to which roles)

items.missingBehavior: Only a flat 2% estimate + one manual final number. No buyer/seller side, office/agent/manager/cooperating split, VAT, referral, adjustment, payment/invoice/collection status, approval, or audit.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Deal close computes commission by configurable split rules (side, office/agent/manager/co-broker %, VAT, referral); payment/collection status tracked; approval + audit; reconciles in reporting by agent/office/period.

items.missingBehavior: No showings/viewings/feedback tables; the listing→viewing→feedback→offer path cannot be captured.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Schedule a viewing (links property+buyer+agent), record outcome + structured feedback, auto-create follow-up, surface interested-buyer status on the property, feed matching.
testsRequired: viewing outcome visible on property + buyer timelines

items.missingBehavior: feedbackPositive is a hard-coded false; no send-to-buyer, no feedback capture, no learning, no stale expiration. Match is a read-only scorecard.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Send a match to a buyer (via comm hub), capture buyer/agent response, feed rejection reason back to scoring, expire stale matches.

items.missingBehavior: Opportunities convert only into a property, never a person (lead/seller). Marketplace cards are dead-ends.
items.acceptanceCriteria: An opportunity can create/attach an owned lead or seller record with source attribution + dedup; outcome tracked back to the opportunity.
testsRequired: no dead-end cards on launch surfaces

items.missingBehavior: Flagship inbox uses markDraftSent (manual) though a real WA Cloud API + Gmail send exist; consent/opt-out/quiet-hours absent.
items.acceptanceCriteria: The inbox agents use actually sends via the real provider (gated on connection), logs outbound with delivery/read state, and enforces consent/opt-out.
testsRequired: send via connected provider persists + status updates
items.productDecision: which provider is default for pilot (Cloud API vs personal bridge)

items.missingBehavior: Routing is recommendation-only (no auto-assign/round-robin/rules); first-contact SLA + response-time never computed (avg_response_minutes hardcoded null); no accept/reject; no reopen.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Rules/round-robin auto-assign on capture; first-contact SLA tracked + escalated; response-time computed from real events; accept/reject + reopen transitions.
testsRequired: response time computed from first outbound
items.productDecision: routing policy (round-robin vs fit-score vs territory)

items.missingBehavior: Canonical enum has 8 stages vs 12 in UI (lossy bridge); no exclusivity/financing/due-diligence/handover/cancelled/reopened/counteroffer stages; stage-duration never computed (exited_at never set); board-only, no per-deal page; no win reason; no required-fields-by-stage.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Single canonical stage model covering the full lifecycle; stage duration recorded; per-deal detail page; required-fields-by-stage; win + loss reasons; cooperating-broker.
items.productDecision: canonical stage set + required fields per stage

items.missingBehavior: AI action extraction produces suggestions only; converting a message into a durable task/lead is not fully wired.
items.acceptanceCriteria: From a message, create a task/lead/follow-up that persists and links back to the conversation and person.

items.missingBehavior: Automation subscriber is classify-only; dispatchTrigger has zero callers; delay queue has no cron; action handlers are no-ops; no stale-lead/expiration scanners; no rate limits.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Approved automations execute via the kernel with idempotency+retries; delayed actions resume via cron; rate limits enforced; irreversible/customer-facing actions remain approval-gated.
items.productDecision: which automations may run unattended vs approval-only

items.missingBehavior: Google client is real but writes to google_synced_events; internal meetings are not pushed to Google; the two stores are unbridged.
items.acceptanceCriteria: CRM meetings sync bi-directionally with Google; one source of truth surfaced on /calendar; conflict handling.

items.missingBehavior: channel enum lists providers but no real API; signing is manual record-keeping.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Send for signature via a real provider; status webhook updates signature state; signed file stored privately + audited.

items.missingBehavior: No per-agent/per-source filter UI; no saved views; export is CSV/JSON/MD only (no PDF/Excel).
items.acceptanceCriteria: Filter by agent/source/status/date; save views; export PDF/Excel; numbers reconcile with records.

items.missingBehavior: No multi-select bulk actions on CRM lists; no saved filters.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Multi-select + bulk assign/tag/status/export; save+recall list filters.

items.missingBehavior: No tags, consent/opt-in, Israeli ID (ת"ז), campaign attribution, user-defined custom fields, archive/restore.
items.acceptanceCriteria: Tags, consent flags, ID field, campaign source, custom fields, archive/restore all persist and appear in list/detail/search.
